targets.query:
SELECT
  SUM("FT-0303 Inlet Flow") / 60 AS "Inlet",
  SUM("FT-0306 Outlet Flow") / 60 AS "Outlet"
FROM "mqtt"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time(1d,18h30m)
fill(0)

panels.title: Membrane Daily Inlet and Outlet Flows

targets.query:
SELECT
  SUM("FT-0303 Inlet Flow") / 60 AS "Inlet",
  SUM("FT-0306 Outlet Flow") / 60 AS "Outlet"
FROM "mqtt"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval)
fill(null)

panels.title: Membrane Hourly Inlet and Outlet Flows

targets.query:
SELECT 
	mean("FT-0303 Inlet Flow") AS "FT0303 Inlet Flow (m3/h)",
	mean("FT-0306 Outlet Flow") AS "FT0306 Outlet Flow (m3/h)"
FROM "mqtt" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Membrane Inlet and Outlet Flow Rates (m3/h)

targets.query:
SELECT 
	mean("PT-0121 Instrument Air Inlet Pressure") AS "PT-0121 Instrument Air Inlet Pressure",
	mean("PT-0302 Inlet Pressure of H2S Removal Vessels (V-400 A/B)") AS "PT-0302 Inlet Pressure of H2S Removal Vessels (V-400 A/B)",
	mean("PT-0314 Outlet Pressure of Second Stage Mem") AS "PT-0314 Outlet Pressure of Second Stage Mem",
	mean("PT-0317 Outlet Pressure of Second Stage Mem") AS "PT-0317 Outlet Pressure of Second Stage Mem",
	mean("PT-0707 Inlet Pressure of First Stage Mem") AS "PT-0707 Inlet Pressure of First Stage Mem"
FROM "mqtt" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT 
	mean("TT-0212 Inlet Temp of Low Pressure Cooler (E-201)") AS "TT-0212 Inlet Temp of Low Pressure Cooler (E-201)",
	mean("TT-0307 Inlet Temp of H2S Removal Vessels (V-400 A/B)") AS "TT-0307 Inlet Temp of H2S Removal Vessels (V-400 A/B)",
	mean("TT-0313 Outlet Temp of Second Stage Mem") AS "TT-0313 Outlet Temp of Second Stage Mem",
	mean("TT-0415 Upstream Temp of Dig Gas Filter (F-401)") AS "TT-0415 Upstream Temp of Dig Gas Filter (F-401)",
	mean("TT-0605 Inlet Temp of High Pressure Separator (V-600)") AS "TT-0605 Inlet Temp of High Pressure Separator (V-600)",
	mean("TT-0708 Inlet Temp  of First Stage Mem") AS "TT-0708 Inlet Temp  of First Stage Mem",
	mean("TT-0918 Inlet Temp of Second Stage Mem") AS "TT-0918 Inlet Temp of Second Stage Mem"
FROM "mqtt" 
WHERE $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
